# Will It Run: map of the code

Read this first, then the card of the package you will touch. For symbols, lines and callers use `codegraph explore "<question>"`; for what happened before, `willitrun memory search`. Rules and commands are in `AGENTS.md`.

## Scripts (`scripts/`)

- `scripts/build_context.py`: Write ``docs/map/``: a map of Will It Run made from the code itself, for any LLM that has to change it.
- `scripts/build_locale.py`: Check and build the Italian UI catalog.
- `scripts/build_seed_catalog.py`: Build Will It Run's offline seed catalog from llmfit's model database.
- `scripts/check.py`: Run the checks that matter for what you changed, and only those.
- `scripts/list_core_strings.py`: List every string the core passes to ``tr()`` and report the ones without an Italian translation.
- `scripts/make_hardware_fixtures.py`: Generate the Windows hardware fixtures used by the test suite.
